drhp.business: Who We Are Green Asia Impex Limited (“We” or “Company”) is engaged in the business of sourcing, processing, manufacturing and export of frozen shrimps and dried chillies. Our Company was incorporated in 2014 and headquartered in Tadepalligudem, Andhra Pradesh, India. Our Company is recognized as a Two Star Export House by the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Directorate General of Foreign Trade.
drhp.one_liner: Our Company operates a shrimp processing facility located at Unguturu, Tadepalligudem, Andhra Pradesh, with a built-up area of approximately 1,838.76 sqm.
